item.title: Excellence on display at 12th Annual Black History Month Showcase
item.description: In Vallejo, Black excellence is more than history. It’s living legacies. On Thursday night, those legacies came alive through song and dance. Students from nine Vallejo schools came together at the Vallejo High School auditorium in a collaborative showcase of Black pride. The African-American Parent Network event marked the 12th annual Black History Month Celebration.
